class_descriptions.NonDemented: Cognitively normal control with no clinical signs of dementia
class_descriptions.VeryMildDemented: Earliest detectable cognitive impairment (Mild Cognitive Impairment equivalent)
class_descriptions.MildDemented: Mild clinical Alzheimer's disease with moderate memory impairment
class_descriptions.ModerateDemented: Advanced clinical Alzheimer's disease with pronounced neurodegeneration
